A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 16-page versions of Buffer layers for Test-Time Adaptation, including Appendices A.1–A.6. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable assessment of all dimensions.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments on four benchmarks, architectural ablations, forgetting experiments, and appendix feature analyses.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendices A.3–A.5.

M1.justification: The parallel convolutional Buffer modules, adaptation objectives, backbone freezing, and optional normalization co-updates are unchanged. Appendix A.2 retains the same Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both evaluate CIFAR10-C, CIFAR100-C, CIFAR10-W and ImageNet-C, retaining the same CIFAR10-W subsets and continuous, mixed-domain, and forgetting scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including TENT, EATA, SAR, DeYO, CMF, ROID, RoTTA, CoTTA and AdaContrast. Appendix A.5 retains the same Source and Oracle comparisons.

E3.justification: Batch sizes, architectures, corruption severity, optimization settings and evaluation metrics are unchanged. Appendix A.4 retains both moving-statistics and fixed-statistics forgetting protocols.

E4.justification: Section 4.3 retains the same module-design, insertion-location and scaling-initialization ablations. Forgetting, mixed-domain and feature-distribution analyses in the main text and appendices are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Section 4.1 continues to specify three random seeds and reporting means or means with standard deviations. No uncertainty-reporting practice or run-count information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted curves and reported findings are retained. Figure 3's caption correction aligns its color descriptions with the existing legend; it does not change the results or the stated forgetting comparison.

T1.justification: Mathematical expressions are unchanged, and neither version contains formal theorems or proofs. Appendix A.6 retains the same conceptual explanation.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims of modular source-free adaptation, broad compatibility, performance benefits and resistance to catastrophic forgetting.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, the interpretation of source-statistics evaluation in Appendix A.4, and Section 5's limitations concerning architecture, scaling initialization and adaptation objectives are unchanged.

D1.justification: Appendices A.1–A.2 retain identical implementation settings, hardware information, initialization details and pseudocode. The code-access link is unchanged.

R1.justification: The same 30 references and research positioning are retained, including the comparisons with EcoTTA and L-TTA. The conference notice does not revise the relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: v3 corrects the author-email grouping, replaces the Preprint notice with a NeurIPS 2025 conference notice, and updates the arXiv stamp. The narrative and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 3's caption changes from blue=Buffer/red=BN to blue=BN/red=Buffer, matching the unchanged legend. Figure 5 italicizes Buffer in its caption. Figures, tables and their placement otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Correcting Figure 3's reversed caption colors resolves a contradiction with its legend and prevents misattribution of the forgetting curves. This provides a limited improvement in reporting clarity; the scientific methods, results and appendix evidence remain unchanged.
